In this work, we systematically evaluate and establish domain-informed and task-specific strategies for adapting pathology foundation models to single-cell spatial gene expression prediction. Using paired H&E and Xenium 5K data, our approach improves mean gene-wise Pearson correlation by 2.67x over the standard zero-shot baseline and achieves state-of-the-art performance on this task. We demonstrate strong gene-detection performance across the full gene panel (AUROC = 0.800) and importantly identify that predictive performance varies substantially across biological contexts, with our model achieving its highest Pearson correlation for spatially variable genes (r = 0.643). Our findings demonstrate that, despite the challenges of sparse single-cell measurements, H&E-derived representations can recover biologically meaningful spatial expression patterns, highlighting both the opportunities and limitations of morphology-based molecular inference at cellular resolution.

summary.takeaway: 系统评估并适配病理基础模型用于从H&E图像预测单细胞空间基因表达，相比零样本基线显著提升基因相关性，并达到当前最优性能。
summary.methods: 使用配对的H&E和Xenium 5K数据，设计领域知识与任务特定的适配策略，评估基因水平Pearson相关性和基因检测AUROC，并分析不同生物语境下的性能变化。
summary.relevance: 涉及预训练模型在生物医学图像分析中的应用与适配，与预训练主题相关，展示了基础模型在细粒度细胞级预测任务上的潜力与局限。
summary.caveat: 单细胞测量稀疏性带来挑战；预测性能在不同生物语境下差异大，空间可变基因上相关性最高（r=0.643），但未说明在其他基因类型上的具体表现；结论基于特定数据集。

papers.title: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction and Robust Evidence Retrieval for Indian Knowledge Systems
papers.abstract: Retrieving evidence from Indian Knowledge Systems is complicated by transliteration variants, ambiguous names, and relations distributed across passages. We present an ontology-guided knowledge graph (KG) pipeline that links typed entities and relations extracted with Qwen3-32B to original textual evidence. Retrieval combines sense-aware grounding, bounded graph traversal, lexical anchors, relationship-vector search, and passage reranking. We evaluate KG alone, single-vector retrieval (SV), and KG unions with SV and Entity Notes on 320 questions from Dhara Bench, matching the per-question candidate count across internal systems under BGE and Qwen rerankers. Standalone KG has the highest Precision@5 under both rerankers and the highest MRR@20 in Counting, Composite, and Multi-hop among the evaluated internal configurations. With Qwen, KG achieves Multi-hop MRR@20 of 0.8722, compared with 0.7622 for the fully reranked KG + SV union. The KG + SV + Entity Notes union instead provides the highest overall Recall@20 (0.5134), compared with 0.4347 for KG. On the 15 Multi-hop questions, Qwen KG achieves complete-evidence MRR@20 of 0.4651 versus 0.3372 for SV, while both full unions complete ten questions within twenty results compared with nine for KG. Gemini 3.7 Flash, evaluated through manually reviewed source mappings, re mains stronger on overall MRR and nDCG, while internal systems have category-specific advantages. All comparisons are descriptive. A separate deployment timing study measures mean retrieval times of 20.374 s for KG and 0.646 s for SV. The findings support selecting KG or its unions according to the required balance of early relevance, evidence completeness, and retrieval cost.

summary.takeaway: 提出本体引导的知识图谱构建与鲁棒证据检索流程，用于印度知识系统，结合类型化实体关系抽取与多种检索策略，并在Dhara Bench上评估。
summary.methods: 使用Qwen3-32B抽取实体和关系构建KG，检索结合语义感知 grounding、有界图遍历、词汇锚点、关系向量搜索和段落重排；比较KG单独、单向量检索及其并集在320个问题上的表现。
summary.relevance: 聚焦知识图谱构建与检索，与知识图谱主题直接相关，展示了KG在复杂多跳检索中的优势与成本权衡。
summary.caveat: 所有比较为描述性，未进行统计显著性检验；KG检索时间（20.374秒）远高于单向量检索（0.646秒），部署成本较高；Gemini 3.7 Flash在整体指标上仍更强。

papers.title: Personalized Affective Perception via Continual Learning in Human-Agent Negotiation
papers.abstract: Self-interested intelligent agents that negotiate with humans should interpret nonverbal expressions and adapt their behavior accordingly. However, generic facial-affect models degrade across individuals and contexts, creating a generalization gap. We introduce an affect-adaptive negotiation strategy that incorporates Continual Learning with Imagination for Facial Expression Recognition (CLIFER) to personalize valence-arousal perception in real time. Differential feedback converts changes in valence-arousal direction and intensity into adjustments of the agent's target utility. An asynchronous architecture updates CLIFER in the background during live interaction. In a counterbalanced within-subject study in which 66 participants negotiated with a humanoid robot, the CL-enabled agent achieved significantly higher individual utility and elicited higher participant concession rates than the FaceChannel baseline. The CL condition yielded significantly higher mean arousal estimates, alongside a broader output range. Participant utility and Nash distance did not change significantly between conditions. These outcomes support the practical value of coupling continual affective personalization with differential feedback for real-time negotiation.

summary.takeaway: 引入情感自适应谈判策略，结合持续学习与想象进行面部表情识别（CLIFER），实时个性化效价-唤醒感知，并在人机谈判实验中提升个体效用和让步率。
summary.methods: 采用异步架构在交互中后台更新CLIFER，通过差分反馈将效价-唤醒变化转化为智能体目标效用调整；66名参与者与仿人机器人进行被试内平衡实验。
summary.relevance: 涉及持续学习在个性化情感感知中的应用，与持续学习主题匹配，展示了在线适应个体差异的方法。
summary.caveat: 实验样本量有限（66人），且仅在特定谈判场景中验证；参与者效用和纳什距离未显著变化，泛化到其他交互场景需进一步验证。

papers.title: Unipolar Neuron Networks Trained by Recirculation for Reward-Based Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Unipolar neurons are the predominant type of nerve cell in the octopus and in most other invertebrates. A single neurite (a fiber extending from the cell body) branches into a tree that carries both input and output synapses. The branches send graded local outputs to nearby cells, and one site on the main neurite sends a global output to distant targets. This paper proposes a network of such neurons and a learning rule for it. Each neuron is modeled as a tree of passive segments, whose activations are computed exactly as the steady state of a linear system. The network learns from reward alone, with a rule called recirculation. After each forward pass, a second pass sends requested changes of the outputs back through the same connections. Each synapse then adjusts its weight using only quantities available at its own location. Because the system of each neuron is symmetric, this update closely follows the gradient of the error in the predicted reward. Two mechanisms limit forgetting when tasks are learned in sequence: a task code inhibits a different subset of branches in each task, while consolidation lowers the learning rate of synapses that changed strongly in the recent past. The model is evaluated on a sequence of MNIST and Iris tasks. The network maintains high accuracy with low forgetting, whereas gradient-based training of the same network forgets earlier tasks almost completely.

summary.takeaway: 提出由单极神经元组成的网络及再循环学习规则，仅依赖奖励信号学习，并通过任务代码和巩固机制减少持续学习中的遗忘。
summary.methods: 每个神经元建模为被动分段树，激活计算为线性系统稳态；学习规则通过第二次前向传递回传输出变化请求，突触局部调整权重；在MNIST和Iris任务序列上评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及持续学习与基于奖励的学习规则，与持续学习主题相关，探索了非梯度-based的生物学启发方法。
summary.caveat: 仅在简单任务序列（MNIST、Iris）上评估，未在更复杂或大规模任务上验证；摘要未提供与其它持续学习方法的全面比较。

papers.title: HiddenPathQA: A Benchmark for Knowledge Graph Question Answering When Questions Hide Their Paths
papers.abstract: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) systems are typically evaluated on questions whose surface tokens lexically expose the gold KG path. Users, however, may ask questions without knowing the underlying schema: "Which condition could Andrew have due to family history?" compresses a 4-hop chain "Andrew --[father]--> parent --[father]--> grandparent --[medical condition]--> disease --[subclass of]--> hereditary disorder" into a single phrase (family history) that names none of those relations. We identify this collapse of path-question alignment as a blind spot in existing KGQA evaluation. Three major LLM-KG paradigms, hop-by-hop exploration, plan-then-retrieve, and similarity-based retrieval, implicitly rely on such lexical cues, an assumption rarely tested in practice. We make three contributions. (i) We introduce HiddenPathQA, a manually verified benchmark of 1,055 questions spanning 2-6 hops and multiple domains, constructed so that question wording does not reveal the gold path's relations. (ii) We propose Holistic Path Selection, which compares questions against candidate relation chains in the local subgraph as complete units, replacing irreversible per-hop relation scoring with globally informed chain-level reasoning. We develop two implementations, TieredHolistic and FlatHolistic. (iii) We conduct a pseudoword stress test that replaces entity names with meaningless placeholders to distinguish KG-grounded reasoning from entity-level memorization. Holistic Path Selection outperforms six strong KGQA baselines (ToG, PoG, FiDeLiS, R2-KG, KAPING, and KARPA) by 8.8-17.9 accuracy points across two LLM backbones and both original and pseudoword settings. Its advantage under pseudoword replacement shows that the gains cannot be explained by entity-level memorization alone.

summary.takeaway: 识别出现有KGQA评估中问题表面词法暴露金标准路径的盲点，提出HiddenPathQA基准和整体路径选择方法，在隐藏路径问题上显著优于六个基线。
summary.methods: 构建含1,055个问题（2-6跳）的手工验证基准，问题措辞不揭示金标准路径关系；提出Holistic Path Selection，在局部子图中整体比较问题与候选关系链，并开发TieredHolistic和FlatHolistic实现；进行伪词压力测试。
summary.relevance: 直接针对知识图谱问答评估与方法改进，与知识图谱主题高度相关，揭示了现有LLM-KG范式的局限。
summary.caveat: 基准规模有限（1,055问题），可能未覆盖所有领域；方法在特定LLM骨干上评估，泛化到其他模型需进一步验证；伪词测试虽排除实体记忆，但未完全消除其他潜在偏差。

papers.title: Anchor Behavior, Not Parameters: Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning with a Single Shared Prompt
papers.abstract: Prompt-based continual learning adapts a frozen pre-trained vision transformer by tuning a small set of prompt tokens. Recently, one-prompt methods which share one single prompt across all tasks make this paradigm maximally parameter efficient. The open question is how a shared prompt can keep the knowledge of old classes while being updated for new ones. Existing methods protect old knowledge in parameter space, where they freeze task-specific prompts, expand new components, or sparsely gate which tokens receive gradients. However, this method sacrifices plasticity, yet the drift it still permits in shared tokens can corrupt the prompt's function on past classes. What must be preserved is the prompt's behavior. We propose TEA-Prompt, which couples (i) a token evaluation module that assigns each prompt token a continuous, input-conditional relevance score injected into the attention logits, softly specializing tokens across tasks without discarding any of them, and (ii) an attention-behavior anchoring loss that constrains each token's attention output around class-specific query regions using only compact Gaussian query statistics without stored old images, weighted by the token's past relevance. Anchoring the attention value allows the parameters to continue updating freely, as long as their interaction remains unchanged. TEA-Prompt achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with markedly lower forgetting on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 with only 0.38M parameters. Code is publicy available at https://github.com/cuonga1cvp/TEA-Prompt.git

summary.takeaway: 提出TEA-Prompt，通过令牌评估模块和注意力行为锚定损失，在共享单一提示的免排练持续学习中保持旧类知识，实现更低遗忘和更高准确率。
summary.methods: 在冻结的预训练视觉Transformer上，为每个提示令牌分配输入条件相关性分数注入注意力logits，并使用高斯查询统计约束注意力输出；在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R和CUB-200上评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及基于提示的持续学习，与持续学习主题直接相关，展示了参数高效且行为锚定的新思路。
summary.caveat: 仅在图像分类任务上评估，未验证其他模态或任务类型；依赖高斯查询统计的假设可能限制其在复杂分布上的适用性。

papers.title: From Process Models to Composable Agentic Workflows: Combining BPMN, Agents and Enterprise Knowledge
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents can reason, use tools and collaborate. However, coordinating increasingly complex agentic applications becomes difficult to understand, monitor and improve. Decisions distributed across prompts, tool calls and application logic make workflows implicit. We introduce **Recursive Capability Composition**, enabling agents to execute business processes and expose them as reusable Agentic Tools. This paper presents a BPMN-based approach to Agentic Workflows, combining explicit orchestration with autonomous reasoning. SemTalk BPMN models are transformed into executable workflows using a LangGraph/Pregel runtime. Agentic Tasks introduce LLM reasoning at selected activities, while conventional BPMN controls process flows, deterministic decisions, system interactions and human approvals. Agentic Participants provide reusable interfaces for agent behavior or other executable processes. BPMN orchestration makes multi-agent systems more understandable and manageable. Explicit process models provide developers and operators with a shared view of workflow structures and execution progress, facilitating debugging, monitoring and optimization. Enterprise agents also need organization-specific context. Process Models and Knowledge Graphs describe activities, participants, information objects, decisions and relationships between processes. They provide structured knowledge of how an organization operates, supporting informed agent decisions and actions. Our contributions are threefold: 1. **Model-Driven Execution:** Transforming BPMN models into executable Agentic Workflows. 2. **Recursive Capability Composition:** Exposing agents and executable business processes as reusable tools for other agents. 3. **Enterprise Context:** Using Process Models and Ontologies to provide organization-specific knowledge for agent reasoning.

summary.takeaway: 提出递归能力组合方法，将BPMN流程模型转化为可执行Agentic工作流，使智能体能够执行业务流程并将其暴露为可复用工具，结合企业知识图谱提供组织上下文。
summary.methods: 使用SemTalk BPMN模型转换为LangGraph/Pregel运行时执行，在选定活动中引入LLM推理，传统BPMN控制流程；智能体参与者提供可复用接口；利用流程模型和知识图谱描述组织运作。
summary.relevance: 结合BPMN、智能体与企业知识图谱，与知识图谱主题相关，展示了流程模型与KG在智能体工作流中的协同作用。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告定量评估结果或与现有方法的比较；方法依赖BPMN建模质量，且未讨论大规模部署的复杂性和性能。

papers.title: The road ahead for stem cell therapies in type 1 diabetes.
papers.abstract: AIMS: Type 1 diabetes results from autoimmune destruction of insulin-producing pancreatic β-cells. Although exogenous insulin remains the standard treatment, it does not restore physiological glucose regulation. Differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells into β-cells offers a scalable alternative to cadaveric islet transplantation and has progressed rapidly over the past decade, resulting in nine clinical trials at various stages of completion. Despite this progress, durable graft function remains constrained by two major challenges: the absence of key islet microenvironment components, such as vasculature, extracellular matrix and supporting cell types and continued vulnerability to autoimmune and alloimmune rejection. METHODS & RESULTS: This review considers emerging technological approaches to overcome these barriers. Bioengineered niches, including multilineage organoids, functionalized hydrogels, decellularized matrices and bioprinting, aim to recreate the native islet microenvironment, while synthetic biology approaches, such as hypoimmune gene editing, CRISPR-based transcriptional control and stimulus-responsive survival circuits, seek to enhance grafts' resilience. Computational and single-cell approaches, including gene regulatory network analysis and digital twin frameworks, are beginning to provide predictive tools for benchmarking differentiation quality and forecasting graft outcomes. CONCLUSION: Together, these complementary strategies, potentially tailored to individual patients, represent a realistic path towards safer, more effective and durable β-cell replacement therapies for type 1 diabetes.
papers.venue: Diabetic medicine : a journal of the British Diabetic Association

summary.takeaway: 该综述指出，干细胞来源β细胞替代疗法在临床推进的同时，仍受限于胰岛微环境缺失和免疫排斥两大障碍，并提出生物工程微环境、合成生物学改造以及计算/单细胞方法等互补策略有望提升移植物的持久功能。
summary.methods: 综述性文章，未报告原始实验数据；梳理了多谱系类器官、功能化水凝胶、脱细胞基质、生物打印等生物工程方法，低免疫基因编辑、CRISPR转录调控、刺激响应存活回路等合成生物学方法，以及基因调控网络分析和数字孪生框架等计算与单细胞手段。
